chapter: Telephone reels: blues and Bessie Smith
title: Paul Oliver does not credit Johnson for 'Empty Bed Blues'
summary: Rasch says Paul Oliver's book mentions the song and Bessie Smith but not the writer; Johnson says authors are seldom credited.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song

blocks.x: -- by a man named Paul Oliver.

No, he's not related to King Oliver. He talks about -- and he mentions Empty Bed Blues. He mentions Bessie Smith, and he doesn't credit you. He doesn't mention your name. Now, I think that's really negligence, see.
Well, yeah, they seldom mention the author or composer.
I know. I know. But it's wrong. Well, I know even in books people talk about titles but can't remember the authors.
